## Maka v2.8.1 — Windows streaming software

**Current stable build.** Installer **Maka-Setup-2.8.1.exe**, app version **2.8.1**. The addon marketplace is not part of this release.

### What’s new in v2.8.1

- **Game audio** follows the app that owns the gameplay window. Desktop audio stays the full playback device, so a different app no longer shows up on both meters.
- A full-screen gameplay source no longer opens a second copy of the desktop mix.
- Window video capture stays video-only.

### Included from v0.2.8

- Adaptive encode, backup ingest, capture recovery, MAKArelay encode settings, viewer counts, measured latency, and the QoS score.
- Studio names use Maka. The shipped encoder file is `MAKArelay.exe`.

### Windows installer

Download **[Maka-Setup-2.8.1.exe](https://github.com/n0social/maka-streaming-software/releases/download/v2.8.1/Maka-Setup-2.8.1.exe)** from the assets below, or [makalive.stream/download](https://makalive.stream/download).

**Windows SmartScreen** may warn on unsigned builds — *More info* → *Run anyway* if you trust this release.

v0.2.8 remains the previous tag.
